entries.title: Introduction
Aliens: Recommended Reading
PART I Speaking with God/gods
“Christus Apollo” (Ray Bradbury, [1969] 1971) – Aliens and Salvation
The Sinking City (Frogwares, 2019) – Lovecraft’s Aliens and Climate Crisis
“New Cosmogony” (Stanisław Lem, 1979) – Lem’s “Alienomorphic” Model of Communication
Starcraft Saga (Blizzard, 2010–2017) – The Xel’Naga and Perfection in Creation
PART II Cultural Perspectives
Project Fractal (Kostas Charitos, 2009) – Aliens at the Acropolis
Binti (Nnedi Okorafor, 2015) – Africanfuturism and the Meduse
Latin American Science Fiction (Various, 1871–present) – Aliens in the Latin American Imagination
PK (Rajkumar Hirani, 2014) – Close Encounters with Bigots and Intolerance
PART III Alien Media
Half-Life (Valve, 1998–2020) – Aliens in Gaming
XCOM: Chimera Squad (Firaxis, 2020) – Roleplaying the Alien
“The War of the Worlds” (Orson Welles, 1940) – A Fantastic Alien Invasion
Solo: A Star Wars Story (Ron Howard, 2018) – The Musical Alien
H. R. Giger (1940–2014) – A Fur Teacup with Teeth
Alien Abduction: Incident in Lake County (Dean Alioto, 1998) – Adaption and the Alien
PART IV Gendering the Alien
The Orions (Star Trek, 1966–2020) – Slave Girls in Space
Per Aspera Ad Astra (Richard Viktorov, 1980) – The Non-Sentimental Female Alien
Kirk and Spock (1967–present) – Slash, Aliens and Desire
I, Vampire (Jody Scott, 1984) – Lesbians, Vampires and Aliens
PART V Otherness and the Alien
Starship Troopers (Paul Verhoeven, 1997) – Militarism and Dehumanisation
The Day the Earth Stood Still (Robert Wise, 1951) – Alienating the Aliens
The Ballad of Beta-2 (Samuel R. Delany, 1964) – Representations of Race
“The Dance of the Changer and the Three” (Terry Carr, 1973) – Posthuman (Un)translatability
The Doctor (Various, 1963–present) – Loving the Alien
PART VI The Human Present and the Alien Future
No Word from Gurb (Eduardo Mendoza, 1990 [Trans. 2007]) – Laughing with the Alien
The War of the Worlds Adaptations (2013–2015) – Real Aliens and Post-Truth
Save Yourselves! (Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Mitchell, 2020) – The Familiar and the (Un)tellurian Other
Arrival (Denis Villeneuve, 2016) – Aliens Outside Time
Chaos Walking Trilogy (Patrick Ness, 2008–2010) – Rejecting the Anthropocene
